title: Pocketwire Rewards Points Ledger Standard: Merchant Refunds and the Clawback Window
content:
On Pocketwire Rewards tiers whose refund setting claws back points, a merchant refund linked to an earning purchase on the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card claws back points only when it posts within the clawback window counted from the purchase date.

## Standard

1. On tiers whose points clawed back on merchant refund setting is Yes, the clawback applies when a merchant refund linked to an earning purchase posts.
2. The former clause under which the points earned on that purchase were clawed back in proportion to the refunded share of the purchase, base, category, direct-deposit and boost points alike, rounded up to whole points, on the refund date, is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for clawback points.
3. A refund claws back points only when it posts within the clawback window: the refund is dated no later than the tier's clawback window in calendar days after the purchase date.
4. The clawback window is counted in calendar days from the purchase date, the day after the purchase being day 1, and a refund on the last day still claws back.
5. On tiers whose setting does not let a clawback take the balance below zero, the clawback is cut to the points balance and the rest is written off; otherwise the balance may go negative and later earnings fill it first.
6. An unlinked merchant credit, a dispute credit or a refund outside the window never claws back points.

## The clawback window as a time rule

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the purchase date of the refunded card purchase, as recorded on the card ledger |
| Evidence | the card ledger record of the purchase and of the refund, read before the clawback |
| Counting | calendar days, the day after the purchase is day 1 |
| Comparison | the refund date is no later than the last day of the window |
| Boundary | a refund dated on the last day still claws back |
| Outside the window | the refund leaves the points in place |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical window of 120 calendar days)

- A refund dated on day 120 after the purchase is inside the window and claws back.
- A refund dated on day 121 after the purchase is outside the window and leaves the points in place.
- A refund dated the day after the purchase is day 1 and claws back.

## Credits that never claw back

| Credit on the card | Claws back points |
|---|---|
| Merchant refund linked to the earning purchase, inside the window | Yes |
| Merchant refund linked to the earning purchase, outside the window | No |
| Merchant credit not linked to a purchase | No |
| Dispute credit | No |

superseded_clauses: the points earned on that purchase are clawed back in proportion to the refunded share of the purchase — base, category, direct-deposit and boost points alike — rounded up to whole points, on the refund date.
